milestone.name: current connector retry/idempotency classification
key_findings: GitHub role-local create/update/delete remains the live query-reconcilable/CAS surface.
Gmail send_email and Calendar create_event expose no caller-stable idempotency key/identity in the current connector schemas and remain hard-gated for exactly-once.
Gmail create_label explicitly returns an existing label instead of duplicating it, making it naturally idempotent by exposed contract, but cross_field is not authorized to live-test it.

General Calendar update_event is stable-ID query-reconcilable but not CAS in its exposed schema; final field-state convergence must not be conflated with exactly-once notifications/conference side effects.

Calendar set_event_label_silently is the strongest non-repository schema candidate: already-correct no-op plus current-ETag concurrency protection and sendUpdates=none, but remains outside this role's live-write boundary.
Gmail bulk query mutations are not exact replay by query alone because the target set can change between retries; exact replay requires frozen message IDs.
milestone.design_revision: Connector actions are now classified per retry semantics rather than as a monolithic external-effect class, while authority and side-effect scope remain explicit.

still_unresolved: arbitrary environment-sensitive compile/test/dependency execution without a hosted executor
opaque caller-keyless sends/creates under ambiguous completion
binary storage beyond low-volume text without quota-bearing route
protected or privileged authority unavailable to scheduled Chat

frontier.action: Add malformed, forward-reference and signed-64-bit overflow controls to bounded-int-dataflow-v1; all must fail closed without expanding semantics.
Use reachability from publication heads to classify the stale orphan segment as garbage in an isolated fixture, then test delete interruption/duplicate retry without touching authoritative evidence.

Explore whether a finite content-addressed textual chunk/manifest scheme can exactly represent one small binary-semantics requirement without relying on LFS/artifact/package quotas; reject if durable byte identity, not semantic content, is material.

exact_next_action: Create three negative controls for bounded-int-dataflow-v1: forward reference/cycle, signed-64 overflow, and claim mismatch. Evaluate each under the frozen language semantics and persist FAIL classifications. Then build a role-local orphan reachability set rooted at current fixture HEAD and prove the stale segment b68a4c... is unreachable before any isolated deletion test.
